ipos.prose:
As of today, the EverestIMS Technologies IPO grey market premium is ₹40 at the median of 7 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹30 and ₹42. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Trackers differ by about 30% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Set against the upper price band of ₹85, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 47.06% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 90.31× overall — strong. The issue is open for bidding now (29 Sep – 5 Oct) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (69/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. On the timeline, the EverestIMS Technologies IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 6 Oct, with listing expected 8 Oct. For the EverestIMS Technologies IPO, one lot is 1600 shares and the issue size is ₹48.46 Cr. See also EverestIMS Technologies IPO subscription status and EverestIMS Technologies IPO allotment status. This EverestIMS Technologies IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
The Acme India Industries IPO grey market premium (GMP) stands at a median of ₹30 today, drawn from 7 trackers we monitor — with individual quotes running from ₹14 to ₹32. That is ₹17 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Note the disagreement: trackers are 60% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹196 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 15.31%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 2.86× overall — healthy. The issue is open for bidding now (30 Sep – 6 Oct) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (59/100); the full breakdown is below.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. On the timeline, the Acme India Industries IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 7 Oct, with listing expected 9 Oct. For the Acme India Industries IPO, one lot is 600 shares and the issue size is ₹121.69 Cr. See also Acme India Industries IPO subscription status and Acme India Industries IPO allotment status. This Acme India Industries IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the TNA Solutions IPO at a median premium of ₹10 — the midpoint of 6 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹9 to ₹10. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Quotes cluster tightly across trackers, the mark of a comparatively liquid grey market.

Set against the upper price band of ₹70, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 14.29% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 2.36× overall — healthy. The issue is open for bidding now (30 Sep – 6 Oct) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (79/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. On the timeline, the TNA Solutions IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 7 Oct, with listing expected 9 Oct. For the TNA Solutions IPO, one lot is 2000 shares and the issue size is ₹37.86 Cr. See also TNA Solutions IPO subscription status and TNA Solutions IPO allotment status. This TNA Solutions IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
As of today, the Vishal Nirmiti IPO grey market premium is ₹7.5 at the median of 6 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹4 and ₹20. That is ₹12.5 below yesterday's median — the premium has cooled a step. Note the disagreement: trackers are 213.3% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Set against the upper price band of ₹220, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 3.41% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 1.45× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (30 Sep – 5 Oct) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (48/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the Vishal Nirmiti IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 6 Oct, with listing expected 8 Oct. For the Vishal Nirmiti IPO, one lot is 68 shares and the issue size is ₹178.00 Cr. See also Vishal Nirmiti IPO subscription status and Vishal Nirmiti IPO allotment status. This Vishal Nirmiti IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
As of today, the Nityas Gems & Jewellery IPO grey market premium is ₹1 at the median of 7 trackers, with quotes spread between ₹1 and ₹3. The median has slipped ₹2 since yesterday, pointing to softening unofficial demand. Note the disagreement: trackers are 200% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Set against the upper price band of ₹75, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 1.33% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 1.61× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (30 Sep – 5 Oct) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (68/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. On the timeline, the Nityas Gems & Jewellery IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 6 Oct, with listing expected 8 Oct. For the Nityas Gems & Jewellery IPO, one lot is 200 shares and the issue size is ₹108.35 Cr. See also Nityas Gems & Jewellery IPO subscription status and Nityas Gems & Jewellery IPO allotment status. This Nityas Gems & Jewellery IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
The Omara Ventures IPO grey market premium is still at zero across the 5 trackers we track — typical before dealers begin quoting, especially ahead of the price band or dates. We poll every tracker hourly, so the first quoted premium appears here as soon as it is published — dealers usually begin quoting around the price-band announcement, and almost always by the time bidding opens.

On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.97× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (30 Sep – 5 Oct) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. No confidence grade is published while no tracker is quoting a premium — there would be nothing for it to measure.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. On the timeline, the Omara Ventures IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 6 Oct, with listing expected 8 Oct. For the Omara Ventures IPO, one lot is 400 shares and the issue size is ₹41.99 Cr. See also Omara Ventures IPO subscription status and Omara Ventures IPO allotment status. This Omara Ventures IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

subscription_faq.q: How many times is the SJP Ultrasonic IPO subscribed?
subscription_faq.a: The SJP Ultrasonic IPO is subscribed 1.18 times overall so far. In the retail category an oversubscribed issue is allotted by computerised lottery, so every valid one-lot application has the same chance.

subscription_faq.q: When does the SJP Ultrasonic IPO close?
subscription_faq.a: The SJP Ultrasonic IPO bidding window is 30 Sep – 5 Oct. Subscription figures are published by the exchanges through the day and are final only after the book closes.

subscription_faq.q: What is the SJP Ultrasonic IPO lot size?
subscription_faq.a: One lot of the SJP Ultrasonic IPO is 2000 shares, at a price band of Rs 67.0.

subscription_faq.q: Does high subscription mean I will get SJP Ultrasonic IPO allotment?
subscription_faq.a: No. A heavily subscribed issue means the opposite: allotment in the retail category is decided by lottery, so the more applications there are, the lower each one's chance. Subscription measures demand, not your odds.

allotment_faq.q: When is the SJP Ultrasonic IPO allotment date?
allotment_faq.a: The basis of allotment for the SJP Ultrasonic IPO is expected on 6 Oct, with listing expected on 8 Oct. The registrar and the exchanges publish status on that date; no third-party site can show it earlier.

allotment_faq.q: How do I check SJP Ultrasonic IPO allotment status?
allotment_faq.a: Check on the registrar's official allotment page, on the BSE application-status page, or with your broker — by PAN, application number or DP/client ID. All three are free. If you applied by UPI, the mandate being debited is often the earliest signal.

allotment_faq.q: Was the SJP Ultrasonic IPO oversubscribed?
allotment_faq.a: The SJP Ultrasonic IPO is subscribed 1.18 times overall. Retail allotment is therefore by lottery.

faq.q: How subscribed is Eventions IPO?

faq.q: Is the GMP reliable for Eventions IPO?
faq.a: No confidence grade is published for Eventions yet. 5 trackers we monitor list the issue, but none is quoting a grey market premium for it, and a grade measures how much to trust a premium — coverage, agreement between trackers, and steadiness over time. With no premium quoted there is nothing for any of those to measure, so we publish no score rather than one built on absence.

faq.q: What are the dates for Eventions IPO?
faq.a: Eventions IPO dates: 30 Sep – 5 Oct — currently open. Under the T+3 listing timeline, allotment is typically finalised about one working day after the issue closes, with listing around three working days after close. Confirm exact dates in the RHP and on the registrar's site.

faq.q: When is the Eventions IPO allotment date?
faq.a: The basis of allotment for Eventions IPO is expected to be finalised on 6 Oct. Listing is expected on 8 Oct. This date is derived from the standard T+3 timeline (allotment the working day after close), not announced — confirm it on the registrar's site.

faq.q: What is the lot size and minimum investment for Eventions IPO?
faq.a: One lot of Eventions IPO is 1200 shares. At the upper end of the price band (₹118), the minimum retail application is ₹2,83,200 for 2 lots. Retail applications are made in whole lots only.

faq.q: What is the issue size of Eventions IPO?
faq.a: The Eventions IPO issue size is ₹38.12 Cr, and it is a SME issue. Issue size is the total amount the company is raising, and it is one of the factors that decides how much stock reaches retail applicants.

faq.q: Who is the registrar for Eventions IPO?
faq.a: The registrar for Eventions IPO is Mudra RTA Ventures Private Limited. The registrar processes applications and finalises the basis of allotment, and its website is where allotment status is checked once results are published.

faq.q: What are Eventions's revenue and profit?
faq.a: Revenue from operations: FY26 ₹99.74 crore, FY25 ₹87.53 crore, FY24 ₹86.57 crore. Revenue grew 13.9% year-on-year in FY26. Profit after tax was ₹7.72 crore in FY26, ₹5.13 crore in FY25, ₹3.29 crore in FY24. These are restated figures from the company's own Red Herring Prospectus, page 59 — the SEBI-mandated disclosure filed with the exchange.

ipos.prose:
The Dove Soft IPO grey market premium is still at zero across the 5 trackers we track — typical before dealers begin quoting, especially ahead of the price band or dates. We poll every tracker hourly, so the first quoted premium appears here as soon as it is published — dealers usually begin quoting around the price-band announcement, and almost always by the time bidding opens.

On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 0.95× overall — modest so far. The issue is open for bidding now (30 Sep – 5 Oct) — see the full IPO calendar for what opens next. No confidence grade is published while no tracker is quoting a premium — there would be nothing for it to measure.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. On the timeline, the Dove Soft IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 6 Oct, with listing expected 8 Oct. For the Dove Soft IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹73.26 Cr. See also Dove Soft IPO subscription status and Dove Soft IPO allotment status. This Dove Soft IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

subscription_faq.a: The SRIT India IPO is subscribed 125.16 times overall so far. In the retail category an oversubscribed issue is allotted by computerised lottery, so every valid one-lot application has the same chance.

subscription_faq.q: Does high subscription mean I will get SRIT India IPO allotment?

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO at a median premium of ₹24.5 — the midpoint of 4 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹15 to ₹26. The median has slipped ₹0.5 since yesterday, pointing to softening unofficial demand. Note the disagreement: trackers are 44.9% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Set against the upper price band of ₹110, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 22.27% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (59/100); the full breakdown is below.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. The Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 30 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. For the Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO, one lot is 1200 shares. See also Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO allotment status. This Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Shah Investor's Home IPO at a median premium of ₹16 — the midpoint of 6 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹14 to ₹17. That is ₹0.4 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Trackers differ by about 18.8% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Measured off the ₹167 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 9.58%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 38.12× overall — strong. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is high (81/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Shah Investor's Home IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 1 Oct; the listing date has not been published yet. For the Shah Investor's Home IPO, one lot is 85 shares and the issue size is ₹90.17 Cr. See also Shah Investor's Home IPO subscription status and Shah Investor's Home IPO allotment status. This Shah Investor's Home IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the German Green Steel IPO at a median premium of ₹9.75 — the midpoint of 4 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹9 to ₹11. The median has slipped ₹1.2 since yesterday, pointing to softening unofficial demand. Trackers differ by about 20.5% right now — moderate disagreement, so read the range rather than the median alone.

Measured off the ₹139 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 7.01%; treat it as expectation, not promise. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (65/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The German Green Steel IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 30 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. See also German Green Steel IPO allotment status. This German Green Steel IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Shivchem Agro IPO at a median premium of ₹2 — the midpoint of 5 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹1 to ₹2. That is ₹1 above yesterday's median — grey-market demand is firming. Note the disagreement: trackers are 50% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Measured off the ₹62 upper band, that premium works out to an estimated listing gain of roughly 3.23%; treat it as expectation, not promise. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 2.2× overall — healthy. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (53/100); the full breakdown is below.

Being an SME listing, the usual caveat is louder: SME grey markets are shallow, tracker spreads run widest in our data, and a thin market is an easy one to move. The Shivchem Agro IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 1 Oct; the listing date has not been published yet. For the Shivchem Agro IPO, one lot is 2000 shares and the issue size is ₹14.01 Cr. See also Shivchem Agro IPO subscription status and Shivchem Agro IPO allotment status. This Shivchem Agro IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
Right now the grey market is pricing the Pind Hospitality IPO at a median premium of ₹1 — the midpoint of 4 trackers, whose quotes range from ₹1 to ₹2. The median is unchanged from yesterday. Note the disagreement: trackers are 100% apart, which usually points to a thin grey market where any single number deserves skepticism.

Set against the upper price band of ₹99, today's median implies an estimated listing gain of about 1.01% — a sentiment reading, not a forecast. On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 2.71× overall — healthy. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (54/100); the full breakdown is below.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. The Pind Hospitality IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 1 Oct; the listing date has not been published yet. For the Pind Hospitality IPO, one lot is 1200 shares and the issue size is ₹17.82 Cr. See also Pind Hospitality IPO subscription status and Pind Hospitality IPO allotment status. This Pind Hospitality IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
No Runwal Enterprises IPO grey market premium has been reported yet — all 3 trackers we monitor currently quote ₹0, which usually means grey-market activity simply hasn't started. We poll every tracker hourly, so the first quoted premium appears here as soon as it is published — dealers usually begin quoting around the price-band announcement, and almost always by the time bidding opens.

Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is low (36/100); the full breakdown is below.

As a mainboard issue it trades in a deeper grey market, where quotes are typically steadier and more meaningful than on SME boards. The Runwal Enterprises IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 30 Sep; the listing date has not been published yet. See also Runwal Enterprises IPO allotment status. This Runwal Enterprises IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.

ipos.prose:
The Green Asia Impex IPO grey market premium is still at zero across the 4 trackers we track — typical before dealers begin quoting, especially ahead of the price band or dates. We poll every tracker hourly, so the first quoted premium appears here as soon as it is published — dealers usually begin quoting around the price-band announcement, and almost always by the time bidding opens.

On the demand side, the issue is subscribed 1.04× overall — modest so far. Bidding has closed; the premium now tracks expectations into allotment and listing. Our confidence grade on today's number is medium (61/100); the full breakdown is below.

A structural caution applies: this is an SME issue, and SME grey markets are thin — our own data shows tracker disagreement is consistently widest here, and small markets are the easiest to paint. On the timeline, the Green Asia Impex IPO allotment date (basis of allotment) is 2 Oct, with listing expected 7 Oct. For the Green Asia Impex IPO, one lot is 1600 shares and the issue size is ₹60.10 Cr. See also Green Asia Impex IPO subscription status and Green Asia Impex IPO allotment status. This Green Asia Impex IPO GMP page is rebuilt frequently throughout market hours, so the premium above is today's, not a figure left over from the day the issue opened.
